meta.title: Implement ForestRun performance benchmark system with GitHub Actions
meta.body_summary: Add comprehensive performance benchmark system for ForestRun cache with configurable statistical confidence, GitHub Actions integration, and comparison against Apollo's InMemoryCache.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot built a large benchmark system over many iterations guided by maintainer feedback; ultimately closed after extensive review without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 30478 changed lines, this is a very large addition by absolute volume, mostly adding a new benchmark package with many files, making it a substantial feature PR. It was closed without merge after extensive iterative review and remained incomplete.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer pavelglac repeatedly requested simpler, more focused benchmark implementation, questioning statistical methods, asking for removal of comparison caches, deletion of build artifacts, and insisting on precise cache operation measurements.
review_details.performance_claim: Provides a benchmark system to measure ForestRun cache operation performance against Apollo's InMemoryCache.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed without merge after multiple iterations; maintainer found the implementation overly complex, statistical methods flawed, and not meeting requirements.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot attempted to build a complex benchmarking system but struggled with statistical correctness, unnecessary complexity, and following maintainer's design preferences. Required explicit step-by-step guidance and multiple iterations, ultimately not merged.

detection_detail.code_reading: pavelglac reviewed code and found issues with archived library usage, hardcoded mock data, complexity, statistical calculations, build artifacts.
detection_detail.manual_testing: pavelglac ran benchmarks and observed that results differed by 20% between identical runs, indicating flawed confidence calculations.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Maintainer reported that two runs with 99% confidence differed by 20%, indicating the statistical methods were incorrect; no stable, reproducible results were achieved.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix-in-pr after maintainer's later comments.

core_change_summary.description: Added packages/apollo-forest-run/benchmarks/performance/ with benchmark suite using custom NiceBenchmark, mock data generators, multiple GraphQL queries, and GitHub Actions workflow for ForestRun cache performance measurement. Later moved to new package @graphitation/apollo-forest-run-benchmarks.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Subsequent commits removed and re-added many files as the implementation evolved; final state includes benchmark code and CI workflow.
change_trajectory: Initial commits added benchmark infrastructure with archived benchmark library and hardcoded mock data.
Maintainer requested removal of archived library; custom NiceBenchmark implemented.
Mock data replaced with dynamic GraphQL-aware generator.
Code was simplified to focus only on ForestRun, more test suites added.
Timing measurement switched to milliseconds with comprehensive cache scenarios.
Statistical confidence calculation was iterated after maintainer found 20% variance between runs.
Configurable confidence levels added, then removed per maintainer request.
Build artifacts from shell scripts were added and later reverted.
Task-based parallelism attempted, then reverted to simple Promise.all due to complexity.
Benchmark code moved to new private package `@graphitation/apollo-forest-run-benchmarks` with yargs for CLI.
Mock data generation replaced with static JSON responses and observer tests expanded.
Confidence customization removed, fixed to 99.5%, reliability checks added.
Measurement isolation refined to measure only cache operations with direct hrtime calls.
Maintainer continued to identify issues with measurement isolation; PR closed without merge.

review_signals.summary: Multiple automated benchmark reports posted showing performance changes between baseline and current.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial benchmark framework.
Maintainer provided iterative feedback over several weeks, requesting specific changes in design, statistics, and code structure.
Copilot made numerous commits addressing each request, but often introduced new issues (build artifacts, flawed parallelism, incorrect formulas).
Maintainer manually tested and found statistical inconsistencies, demanded precise cache operation measurement.
After extensive back-and-forth (over 50 comments), the PR was closed without merge, as the implementation remained unsatisfactory.
